name: Text Utils
summary: Word counts, case conversion, regex matching, and a scheduled trigger.
description: Counts words, characters and lines; converts case between upper, lower, title, snake and camel; runs a regular expression over text and returns every match. Adds a Transform Text action to the command editor (including Base64 encode and decode) and a Scheduled Time trigger that fires when the machine's local clock reaches a time you name — while Astra is running, so it is not a cron replacement. Requires Python 3.10 or newer on the machine running Astra.
